text:
Ava: Heads up — big spike in TLS failures in APAC after midnight. seeing a flurry of 502s from several services. investigating.
Sanjay: which services? logs?
Ava: auth-gateway-apac, model-ingest-apac, edge-proxy-apac. example log: 
```
2026-03-23T00:03:11Z auth-gateway-apac error: tls: handshake failure: remote error: tls: bad certificate
peer=10.1.2.3
```
Leah: rotator-bot posted rotations done for apac-edge but with non-zero errors. @rotator-bot paste summary please.
rotator-bot: rotation run apac-edge: rotated=19/21 status=partial errors=2 error_codes=[KMS_ACCESS_DENIED, KMS_ACCESS_DENIED]
Darya: that points to key unwrap issues. did we change IAM or IRSA mappings?
Priya: ops merged infra/PR-1423 earlier — it tightened the rotator principal to use `rotator-service-v2` and removed the legacy binding. APAC key policies weren't updated AFAIK.
Sanjay: looking at rotator logs: 
```
2026-03-23T00:02:02Z rotator warn: unwrap failed for key id=arn:aws:kms:apac-1:123456:key/aaaabbbb: AccessDeniedException: not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on resource
stack=unwrap.go:120
```
Ava: so rotator reissued certs but couldn't decrypt some private material -> created certs without matching key material. client side rejects them.
Leah: temporary mitigation options?
Darya: quickest is to add explicit kms:Decrypt permission for `arn:aws:iam::123456:role/rotator-service-v2` in the APAC key policy (scoped only to apac keys). alternative is to rollback role change but that's slower.
Sanjay: I'll push a scoped key policy patch now. creating change with minimal blast radius.
Priya: also check why pod identity flipped from legacy to v2 during recent deploy — could be Helm values or IRSA annotation drift.
rotator-bot: queued rotation retry for apac-edge once key policy changes are detected.
Sanjay: applied key policy patch at 00:17Z (change-id=kms-hotfix-1002). policy snippet: 
```
- Sid: GrantRotatorV2Decrypt
  Effect: Allow
  Principal: arn:aws:iam::123456:role/rotator-service-v2
  Action: kms:Decrypt
  Resource: arn:aws:kms:apac-1:123456:key/*
  Condition: { "StringEquals": { "aws:RequestedRegion": "apac-1" } }
```
Ava: rotator picked up policy change and re-ran. rotator-bot: rotation retry result: rotated=21/21 status=success.
rotator-bot: rotation run complete for apac-edge: status=success rotated=21/21
Leah: can folks confirm handshakes recovered?
Ava: auth-gateway/apac and model-ingest show normal TLS handshakes now. latency back to baseline.
Darya: follow-ups we need to track: 
- infra: add a CI smoke test that verifies rotator principal can decrypt per-region KMS keys (INFRA-1002)
- infra: update PR-1423 docs to list required key policy changes per region
- ops: add a deploy guard to verify IRSA/serviceAccount -> role mapping hasn't changed unexpectedly
- sec: add an alert for KMS AccessDenied on decrypt events that notifies sec-oncall channel
Sanjay: filed INFRA-1002 and linked to PR-1423 for docs update.
Priya: I'll audit the deploy pipeline and IRSA annotations; will revert any accidental identity swaps if found.
Ava: creating incident page: https://incidents.internal/redwood/INC-2026-03124 — adding timeline and logs.
Leah: good catch all. please paste any postmortem notes to the incident and assign owners. closing thread unless something new appears. :white_check_mark:
